study: Portes et al. 2018, Instructional Conversation (IC) culturally-responsive pedagogy PD, AERJ
delivery_evidence: PD was an intensive 100-hour program of in-classroom 'assisted teaching experiences' (learning-by-doing) with trained coaches providing in-person support/feedback during a practice year, plus follow-up coaching (Method: 'intensive 100-hour program of assisted teaching experiences in the implementation of the IC'); no online/remote PD component reported.
test_alignment_evidence: Outcomes are the state Criterion-Referenced Competency Tests (CRCT) in ELA, reading, math, science, social studies, a common state standardized assessment not tailored to the intervention (Measures; Tables 8-13).
curriculum_evidence: IC is a dialogic/socio-cultural pedagogy applied within teachers' existing content-area instruction (small-group discussion practice across content areas); the PD improves teaching practice rather than supplying a new curriculum/materials package (intervention description).
outcome_timing_evidence: CRCT outcomes measured at the end of the efficacy year, same school year as the implemented intervention (Measures; Tables 8-13).
